label: Deep refresh (19 Nov 2026), part C: pregnant woman hypnotized by her own partner, Asia
description: Asian-language pass (19 Nov 2026 PT) for a PREGNANT adult woman hypnotized by her OWN partner (husband, boyfriend, fiancé or live-in partner), in any Asian country or language, across film, TV, serials, soaps, vertical/short dramas, AI-generated series and adult (18+) works. Swept web search in Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Hindi/Hinglish, Telugu/Tamil, Thai, Indonesian, Vietnamese, Filipino, Turkish and Urdu/Pakistani drama terms; short-drama aggregators and Reddit r/CShortDramas; Bilibili, YouTube, TikTok and Instagram via web search; X public search (0 relevant posts); MyDramaList/AsianWiki/KMDb/HKCinema/Douban-type listings; and DLsite official listings plus DLsite's public product API (genre filters 催眠 + ぼて腹/妊婦, 催眠 + 人妻, 催眠 + 妊娠/孕ませ, 催眠 + 寝取らせ, 催眠 + ラブラブ/恋人同士; about 3,200 listings screened). FANZA could not be searched (login wall). The catalog was already close to saturated for this exact plot: every screen lead found was already listed (e.g. 谁也别想动我腹中的孩子, Listen to Your Husband / 听老公的话, Ninnu Kori, The Memory Reset with The Love Erased) or did not meet the brief. Adults only; non-explicit notes; plots only from official listing text; unknowns are marked unknown/not stated. Appended at the true end of SOURCES.

records.title: シュタイン教授の催○調教研究室 (Professor Stein's Hypnosis Training Lab)
records.meta: Adult manga serial · Japan · Japanese · by 瀬名鈴子 (Sena Suzuko) · ぶんか社 / マガジンサイベリア · 5 chapters, about Oct 2023 – 20 Feb 2024 · R18 · DLsite BJ01211781 (ch. 2), BJ01236589 (ch. 3), BJ01262242 (ch. 4), BJ01289051 (final) · final chapter also collected in the pregnancy-theme anthology 淫らな妊婦 (ぶんか社, 20 Feb 2024)
records.character: Professor Stein's unnamed female assistant (an adult research assistant), who later lives with him as his wife
records.summary: Official listing copy: in a world where humans live alongside other races and are seen as less capable, Professor Stein researches ways to raise humans' standing; he was born with the ability to control other people's minds. When the national army asks whether his power could be used for training, his female assistant volunteers, and he uses the power on her (chapters 2–4: he draws out her hidden desires and 'trains' her, and she grows more sensual). In the final chapter, having fled a civil war, Stein changes his name and lives with the assistant as a married couple; she becomes pregnant and then loses her memory.
records.hypnotist: Professor Stein, her employer who later becomes her partner (they live as husband and wife)
records.method: Innate mind-control power (listed as 催眠 / トランス/暗示)
records.pregnant_end: yes — pregnant in the final chapter (birth not stated)
records.pregnancy_outcome: She is pregnant in the final chapter while living with Stein as his wife; the listing does not name the father or state a birth.
records.pregnancy_again: no — first pregnancy as far as the listings say
records.kids_note: No children are mentioned before the pregnancy.
records.kids_together_note: The listing ends on her memory loss while pregnant; whether the couple stay together and raise the child is not stated.
records.fit_note: Partner fit: she is hypnotized / mind-controlled by the man she then lives with as his wife, and she is pregnant in the final chapter. The listings do not say whether he uses his power on her while she is pregnant or whether it causes her memory loss.
